# <span id="aanchor448"></span> Create Systems

Systems can only be created from the System Manager. The system creation process typically proceeds as follows:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 561;height: 191;" />

Administrators must have **Application Process - System** privileges, granted from the User or Group Access screen, to create, edit, and delete systems.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new system:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**, and select **System Manager** within the **Security** group.

2.  Click **New**.

3.  Enter a system name.

4.  Enter a system code if needed (this data is optional and is not displayed elsewhere in the application).

5.  Grant system access to the appropriate users and/or groups.

6.  Assign one or more managers to the system.

    Each system must have at least one manager. A manager can add or remove user or group system access from the System Manager screen.

7.  Click **Save**.

The administrator can then grant users and/or groups access to the system from the User or Group Access screen. Meters, locations, source analyses, lists, and other objects can then be assigned to the system. (Each object can only belong to one system.)

In the Settings Manager, the System group contains system-specific settings, whereas the Application group contains settings that are application-wide and affect all systems.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Edit Approval Limits</a>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">Edit approval limits<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>The maximum amount by which volume, energy, gross standard volume, or mass values can be changed through manual edits without requiring approval. Manual edits that exceed this limit will need to be approved before the edits are applied.</span></a> can be set on a per-system basis. These limits are set in the System Manager screen under the Options tab, or in the System Configuration screen under the PPA and Approval Options tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 351;height: 441;" />

After edit limits have been set, if a user tries to save an edit to meter data that is greater than the approval limit set for that system, a message will display informing the user of the exceeded amount, and the edit will have a status of "Pending".

The limit applies to the total edit amount for the month.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

An edit approval limit for volume is set at 1000 units. An edit is then made to the volume amount that varies 950 units from the original amount. The variance of 950 is below the 1000-unit limit, so no approval is required. The volume is then edited by an additional 60 units. The total variance of the edits (950 + 60) now exceeds the 1000-unit limit, so the second edit of 60 units will require approval. The edit will need to be approved by a user or group with edit approval limits greater than the system-level limit of 1000 units (defined in System Manager or System Configuration).

</div>
